displayName: Build a reading list on a complex topic
summary: Compile the best papers, tools, and resources on any subject and organise them for easy reference.

useCases.title: Build a reading list on a complex topic
useCases.message: Help me build a reading list on a topic I am trying to get up to speed on. Ask me what the topic is and how deep I want to go. Then find the most useful resources across formats such as papers, articles, tools, and communities, and organise them into a document I can work through.
